content:
Sam (Support): Hey team — escalated issue from AcmeCorp (#4321). They report intermittent 401s starting ~2026-03-05 after we rolled key rotation. Error from their logs: `JWT signature verification failed: kid not found in JWKS`. They see ~10% of requests failing, then recover after a few minutes. Can we triage? :rotating_light:

AcmeCorp Support (customer): Reproducer attached. We hit the endpoint with the same token repeatedly and ~1/8 requests return 401. Our clock is synced via NTP. Output: `{
  "error": "invalid_signature",
  "message": "JWT signature verification failed: kid not found in JWKS"
}`

Sam (Support): Repro steps they provided (curl):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_WITH_KID_xyz>" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Olivia (Security): Thanks Sam. Sounds like a JWKS cache + key rotation race. If our runtime caches JWKS and a new kid shows up during rotation, some nodes may still be using old cached set. Should fallback to refetch on kid-mismatch.

Chris (Infra): Confirming. Our current JWKS cache TTL is 300s and refresh is background-only. If a request comes to a worker that hasn't refreshed, and the token key is new, verification fails immediately. We also only refetch on schedule, not on failure.

Maya (SRE): Also want to rule out clock skew — if the token's `iat`/`exp` border is tight, small skew could cause intermittent rejects depending on which verifier sees it. But customer said NTP is enabled. Still worth adding leeway.

Olivia (Security): Agreed. Short-term mitigations we can ask customer to try: 1) Retry client requests a few times (they already see transient success), 2) If possible, request new token (not ideal). For server-side hotfixs: a) refetch JWKS when `kid` not found b) set `leeway` in JWT verification to 120s c) reduce JWKS cache TTL to 60s and make refresh-on-401 immediate.

Chris (Infra): I can push a small runtime fix: check for `kid` mismatch -> synchronous JWKS refetch and retry verification once. Also add env var `JWKS_CACHE_TTL=60` for canary. I'll open a PR.

Maya (SRE): Can we also add metric + alert for `jwt.verification.failures.kid_not_found` so we catch spikes?

Olivia (Security): Yes. Add a histogram for verification latency too. Also capture which `kid` was requested to correlate with rotation events.

Sam (Support): Customer is asking for ETA and temporary workaround. Can we give timeline and a one-line workaround like "enable retries"?

Chris (Infra): ETA: PR + unit tests today (2-3h), deploy to canary in staging in the afternoon, 5% production rollout after smoke tests, full rollout in 30-60m if no regressions. Hotfix will include: synchronous JWKS refetch on `kid` mismatch, and a retry once.

Olivia (Security): Also adding verifier leeway param default 120s in config. Note: we should not accept excessively old tokens; 120s is safe.

Sam (Support): I'll tell the customer: enable client retries for now and we've scheduled a hotfix deployment later today.

AcmeCorp Support (customer): Thanks — retries help in the meantime. Please keep us posted.

Chris (Infra): Putting the quick repro I used for local testing here:
```
# generate token signed with new kid
python3 tools/mk_jwt.py --kid newkey --exp +300 > tmp/jwt
# hammer endpoint
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat tmp/jwt)" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```
Results: typically 3-6 failing 401s per 50 when cache TTL 300s, drops to 0-1 when TTL 60s + refresh-on-401 enabled.

Olivia (Security): Edge cases to be aware of:
- Multi-datacenter rotation: if keys rotate at different times in multiple regions, we must ensure global key propagation or per-region key sync.
- JWKS endpoint transient 502/5xx: refetch-on-401 must handle backoff to avoid thundering herd.
- Signature algorithm changes: verify alg allowed list.

Maya (SRE): I'll add alert rule: `sum(rate(jwt_verification_failures[5m])) by (reason) > 1` to page on `reason=kid_not_found` for high-volume customers.

Sam (Support): Action items: 
- Chris: PR for synchronous refetch on kid-mismatch + env override for TTL (PR #7852) — in progress.
- Olivia: config change for verifier leeway default 120s + allowed alg check.
- Maya: add metric + pager rule.
- Sam: update customer with tentative timeline and workaround.

Chris (Infra): PR opened -> https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pull/7852 (tests included). Will run canary in prod region us-west-1 at 14:30 PT.

deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for `runtime-jwt-fix` -> 5% in us-west-1.

Olivia (Security): Quick note — we should also update docs for integrations: "Clients should tolerate transient 401s around key-rotation and implement exponential backoff + retry once."

AcmeCorp Support (customer): We saw the canary go live and initial numbers look good — failures down to <1%. Thank you.

Maya (SRE): Monitoring looks stable after canary. Planning full rollout in 45m unless we see errors.

Sam (Support): Marking thread as "in-progress" for CS. I'll follow up once full rollout is done. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
